story_type: Navy hovercraft charges out of the surf and across the beach
hook: This Navy boat doesn't stop at the beach. It keeps going.
narration: This Navy landing craft doesn't stop at the beach. It keeps going.
It's a landing craft, air cushion, and these crews from Assault Craft Unit Four were bringing them ashore at Onslow Beach, North Carolina.
Huge fans blow air down into a rubber skirt, so the whole craft rides on a cushion of air instead of a hull.
That cushion lets it carry about sixty tons from a ship straight across the surf line and up onto dry land.
[short pause] When it hits the sand, it throws up its own sandstorm.
outcome: LCAC twenty eight came ashore through its own cloud of sand and settled onto the dunes at Onslow Beach.
title: Navy hovercraft charges up a beach
description:
U.S. Navy landing craft, air cushion (LCAC) with Assault Craft Unit 4 land at Onslow Beach, Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune, North Carolina, on Feb. 27, 2026, during Type Commander's Amphibious Training 26.1.
